Ranked PvP loadout

Teams that clear the whole story (Season 1)

Pick whichever one you can actually build. No two of these share more than one skin, so if you are missing a card the next entry is a genuinely different team rather than the same one with a swap. Clears counts the Season 1 chapters won at least 95% of the time; anything below that is listed as a weak spot and has its own team in the table underneath.

ChWinLeadersSupporters
Win rates are simulated estimates, not the real game. Tap a row to load that team and enemy.

Community builds

Teams other players found, credited to whoever submitted each one first. Every entry is verified automatically and deduped. Story builds rank by win rate across the 21 Season 1 chapters and can't use story-reward skins (those are locked behind story). PvP builds allow any skin and fight each other in a league that re-runs on every new entry, so standings shift as the pool grows.

Submit your team

Shares the team from the Team & Battle tab, if it isn't already on the board. Story builds can't use story-reward skins (DLC and event cards are fine); PvP builds allow any skin but need exactly 4 supporters.

Team code (import / export)
Paste a team code from the game (the "Copy Team ID" button) to load it, or export your current team as a shareable code.

Test your team

PvP fights your team head-to-head against a field of meta decks and reports how you hold up. It needs a full 3 leaders and 4 supporters.

Enemy

A PvP simulation: both sides scale like a player team (level 1-20). Type a card name (a list appears as you type), then a level.

Simulate

The engine replicates the game's battle logic, but its randomness differs, so results are estimates rather than exact predictions.
